# Country scope. One industrial complex with its own new building slot in the capital state.
COLDWAR_CMEA_build_civ = {
	capital_scope = {
		add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
		add_building_construction = { type = industrial_complex level = 1 instant_build = yes }
	}
}

# Country scope. One level of infrastructure in a state that can take it.
COLDWAR_CMEA_build_infra = {
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = PREV infrastructure < 5 } }
		random_owned_controlled_state = {
			limit = { infrastructure < 5 }
			add_building_construction = { type = infrastructure level = 1 instant_build = yes }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The programme modifiers of the country and of its capital state.
COLDWAR_CMEA_add_programme_modifiers = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } }
	capital_scope = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes_state } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes_state } } }
}

			add_to_variable = { cwcm_p_FME = 0.08 }
		}

	}
}

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_opt = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_size = 3 } }

		}
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. After planning: construction starts in a free programme file (service programmes start at once).
COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item > 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item < 140 } }
		# service programme: no construction; the offer works for 180 days at once
		clear_array = cwcm_t_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_by = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_by = {
					if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = cwcm_t_part value = THIS } } } add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS } }
				}
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_service = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_activate_ctx = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_opt = global.cwcm_ctx_opt }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_size = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_start = global.num_days }
			clear_array = global.cwcm_q1_part
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				add_to_array = { global.cwcm_q1_part = THIS }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 141 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 1460 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 142 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 1825 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 143 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 1460 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 144 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 1460 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 145 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 180 }
			}
			# the host always takes part
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host > 0 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.cwcm_q1_host = { exists = yes  } }
					var:global.cwcm_q1_host = {
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_q1_part value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_q1_part = THIS } }
					}
				}
			}
			# sector programmes: the participants pay the cost of the tier at once by GDP share, the host 20 % on top
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item < 140 } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_q1_pay = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 2 }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_opt = global.cwcm_ctx_opt }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_size = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_start = global.num_days }
			clear_array = global.cwcm_q2_part
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				add_to_array = { global.cwcm_q2_part = THIS }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 141 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = 1460 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 142 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = 1825 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 143 } }

			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 144 } }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host = SOV.id }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = 1460 }

				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = 365 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_end = 180 }
			}
			# the host always takes part
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host > 0 } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:global.cwcm_q2_host = { exists = yes  } }
					var:global.cwcm_q2_host = {
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_q2_part value = THIS } } } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_q2_part = THIS } }
					}
				}
			}
			# sector programmes: the participants pay the cost of the tier at once by GDP share, the host 20 % on top
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item < 140 } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_q2_pay = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 3 }

			clear_array = global.cwcm_q3_part
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				add_to_array = { global.cwcm_q3_part = THIS }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 141 } }

				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_end = 180 }
			}
			# the host always takes part
			if = {

	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 11 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 11 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_by } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
	}
}

	}

# Any scope. Programme file 1: the participants pay the tier by GDP share, the host 20 % on top.
COLDWAR_CMEA_q1_pay = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_it = global.cwcm_q1_item }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sz = global.cwcm_q1_size }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_programme_cost = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_q1_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = gdp_total } }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_pg min = 0.001 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_q1_part
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
			divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_pg }
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_cost }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_transition }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.5 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
			modify_treasury_effect = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_q1_host = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwcm_q1_host = {
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwcm_t_cost }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_it/op/sz/host and temp array cwcm_t_part: the offer starts for the participants.
COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_it = 101 } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_run_P1
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P1_opt = cwcm_t_op }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P1_size = cwcm_t_sz }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P1_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P1_end = 1825 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_P1_on = yes }
		}
		# Intermetal: one steel deposit in the capital state of the host (once)
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op = 1 }
				NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_P1_steel }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_host > 0 } }
			set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_P1_steel
			var:cwcm_t_host = { capital_scope = { add_resource = { type = steel amount = 1 } } }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_it = 102 } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_run_P2
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P2_opt = cwcm_t_op }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P2_size = cwcm_t_sz }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P2_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P2_end = 1825 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_P2_on = yes }
		}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_it = 103 } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_run_P3
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P3_opt = cwcm_t_op }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P3_size = cwcm_t_sz }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P3_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P3_end = 1825 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_part

		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_P4_size = cwcm_t_sz }

		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_S10_on = yes }
		}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_it = 131 } }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_run_S11
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_opt = cwcm_t_op }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_size = cwcm_t_sz }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_run_S11_end = 180 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwcm_t_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_S11_on = yes }
		}

	}
}

	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sz = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_host = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = yes
}

		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_host = global.cwcm_q1_host }
		clear_array = cwcm_t_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q1_part
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 12 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q1_end = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes programme file 1.
COLDWAR_CMEA_q1_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_host = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_end = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwcm_q1_part
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_op = global.cwcm_q2_opt }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sz = global.cwcm_q2_size }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_host = global.cwcm_q2_host }
		clear_array = cwcm_t_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q2_part
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 12 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q2_end = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes programme file 2.

	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_host = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_start = 0 }

	clear_array = global.cwcm_q2_part
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item < 140 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_it = global.cwcm_q3_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_op = global.cwcm_q3_opt }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sz = global.cwcm_q3_size }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_host = global.cwcm_q3_host }
		clear_array = cwcm_t_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q3_part
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 12 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q3_end = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes programme file 3.
COLDWAR_CMEA_q3_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 0 }

	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_host = 0 }

	clear_array = global.cwcm_q3_part
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

	# sector programmes: the offer starts now for one five-year plan
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item < 140 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_it = global.cwcm_q4_item }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_op = global.cwcm_q4_opt }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sz = global.cwcm_q4_size }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_host = global.cwcm_q4_host }
		clear_array = cwcm_t_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q4_part
			add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_part = THIS }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_activate = yes
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 12 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q4_end = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes programme file 4.
COLDWAR_CMEA_q4_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_host = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_end = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwcm_q4_part
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. Annual payments for the major projects under construction: the share of their own GDP, the host 20 % more.
COLDWAR_CMEA_programme_costs = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item > 140 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 141 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 142 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 143 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 144 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.005 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q1_item = 145 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.8 }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q1_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_r }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_transition }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_q1_host } }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 1.2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item > 140 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 141 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 142 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 143 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 144 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.005 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q2_item = 145 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.8 }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q2_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_r }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_transition }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_q2_host } }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 1.2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item > 140 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 141 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 142 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 143 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 144 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.005 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q3_item = 145 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.8 }
		}
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_q3_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_r }
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_transition }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.5 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { THIS.id = global.cwcm_q3_host } }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 1.2 }
				}
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item > 140 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item = 141 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item = 142 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.003 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_agreed_plan }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.85 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item = 143 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.0075 }
		}
		else_if = {

			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_r = 0.005 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_q4_item = 145 } }

				}
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. The programmes end for a country that leaves the Council.
COLDWAR_CMEA_clear_programmes = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P1_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P2_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P3_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P4_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P5_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P6_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P7_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P8_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P9_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P10_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_P11_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S1_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S2_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S3_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S4_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S5_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S6_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S7_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S8_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S9_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S10_off = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_S11_off = yes
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M1
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M2
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M3
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M4
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_M5
	set_variable = { cwcm_pm_OR = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_pm_KG = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_pm_IND = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_pm_FO = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_pm_REX = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_prog_pay = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_q1_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_q2_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_q3_part = THIS }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_q4_part = THIS }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes } }
}

# Country scope (recipient). temp cwcm_t_eff: effect factor as in the Cold War code; the Council counts as an Eastern donor.
COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_3_dynamic_modifier } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 1.25 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = imp_eco_1_dynamic_modifier } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 0.6 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mod = 1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mod = modifier@mdcw_cw_assistance_effectiveness }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_mod min = 0 }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = cwcm_t_mod }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_gpc }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 1.1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 1.25 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 } multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = global.mdcw_cw_tier_factor_2 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_eff = 0.75 }
	}
}

# Country scope, called inside mdcw_cw_recalculate_country before the receiver caps: Council programmes add to the received values (same caps as all programmes).
COLDWAR_CMEA_cw_receiver = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = global.cwcm_h1_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = cwcm_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwcm_t_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = global.cwcm_h2_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = cwcm_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwcm_t_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target = THIS.id } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = global.cwcm_h3_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = 0.5 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_sf = cwcm_t_eff }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_construction = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.06 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_research = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_productivity = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_growth = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_eff_max = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_pp = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_sf }
				add_to_variable = { mdcw_cw_r_bureaucracy = cwcm_t_v }
			}
		}
	}

# Country scope (recipient). temp cwcm_t_mult 5 or 15: the United States resent an Eastern programme, scaled by the power rank of the recipient (mirror of the EC rule).
COLDWAR_CMEA_usa_reaction = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = super_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = great_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 1.6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = large_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 1.3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = regional_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = minor_power }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 0.7 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_w = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_op = cwcm_t_w }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_op = cwcm_t_mult }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = USA
			NOT = { tag = USA } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 27.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_30 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 22.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_25 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 17.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_20 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 12.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_15 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 9 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_10 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 7.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_8 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 6 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_7 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 4.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_5 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 3.5 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_4 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_op > 0 } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
				if = {
					limit = { exists = yes }
					USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_usa_aid_3 } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The recipient accepted: a Council programme abroad starts for two years; the interested members pay it.
COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_h = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = global.cwcm_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_size = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = global.cwcm_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_remit = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_h1_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_h1_part = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_h = 2 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = global.cwcm_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_size = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = global.cwcm_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_remit = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_h2_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_h2_part = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_h = 3 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = global.cwcm_ctx_opt }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_size = global.cwcm_ctx_size }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = global.cwcm_ctx_ret }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_start = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_end = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_end = 730 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_remit = 0 }
		clear_array = global.cwcm_h3_part
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_h3_part = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 13 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_by = {
					set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 13 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_done = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recipient
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_ext value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ext = THIS }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		# one-off consequences of the chosen return
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = 4 } }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
				set_variable = { cwcm_reform_until = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_reform_until = 365 }
			}
		}
		var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = 5 }
					check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = 0.5 }
					mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = 1 } }
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
						if = {
							limit = { exists = yes }
							PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_aid_partner_1 } }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = 2 } }
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
						if = {
							limit = { exists = yes }
							PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_aid_partner_2 } }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = 3 } }
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
						if = {
							limit = { exists = yes }
							PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_aid_partner_3 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mult = 15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_mult = 5 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_usa_reaction = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_update_shared_capacity = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
				var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						set_variable = { cwcm_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev8_res = 14 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev8_target = THIS.id } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.8 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 14 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = 14 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. temp cwcm_t_gap: distance to the socialist camp (0.5 communist, 1.5 a government with elections, 1 other).
COLDWAR_CMEA_reform_gap = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_communist_government = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gap = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_elections = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gap = 1.5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gap = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Council programme abroad 1 ends after two years; the shared capacity returns.
COLDWAR_CMEA_h1_end = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_h1_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 120 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_start = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_end = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_remit = 0 }
	clear_array = global.cwcm_h1_part
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes  } }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target = THIS.id } check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target = THIS.id } } }
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recipient
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					set_variable = { cwcm_ev8_item = 120 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev8_res = 15 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.8 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_update_shared_capacity = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
