# Any scope. Weekly end of Council programmes abroad.
COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_h1_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h1_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h1_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_h2_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h2_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h2_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 }
			OR = {
				NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_h3_end } }
				NOT = { var:global.cwcm_h3_target = { exists = yes } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_h3_end = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Monthly (and on every change): cost, recipient lines and the dynamic return of every running Council programme abroad from the real values of the recipient.
COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recompute = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_HM = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZS = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_AS = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_AP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_PW = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_FO = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZI = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ST = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_PP = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_BK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_SK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_KG = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_WE = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_OR = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_IB = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_AK = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_IND = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_MIL = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_REX = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			set_variable = { cwcm_aidw_AK = 0 }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_workers_host
			set_variable = { cwcm_aid_pay = 0 }
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_ext
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_HM = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_ZS = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_AP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_REX = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_RGDP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_AK = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_POP = 0 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_x_OR = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_h1_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_h1_target = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = global.cwcm_h1_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost (Western recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = cwcm_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			# own Council lines on the recipient (agriculture, socialist cadres)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_AP = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			# the return, read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_HM = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_HM = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = cwcm_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_OR = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_IND = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_MIL = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_KG = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_REX = cwcm_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_RGDP = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = 0.08 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_U }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_POP = cwcm_t_v }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_remit = cwcm_t_US }
				multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwcm_h1_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwcm_h1_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwcm_aidw_AK = cwcm_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
		# the interested members pay the programme by GDP share (annual)
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h1_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_pg min = 0.001 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 12 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h1_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_pg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_c }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_aid_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_h2_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_h2_target = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = global.cwcm_h2_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost (Western recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = cwcm_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			# own Council lines on the recipient (agriculture, socialist cadres)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_AP = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			# the return, read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_HM = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_HM = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = cwcm_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_OR = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_IND = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_MIL = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_KG = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_REX = cwcm_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_RGDP = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = 0.08 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_U }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_POP = cwcm_t_v }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_remit = cwcm_t_US }
				multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwcm_h2_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwcm_h2_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwcm_aidw_AK = cwcm_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
		# the interested members pay the programme by GDP share (annual)
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h2_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_pg min = 0.001 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 12 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h2_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_pg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_c }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_aid_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_h3_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_h3_target = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_calc_eff = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = global.cwcm_h3_size }
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_S = 0.5 }
			# monthly cost (Western recipients x1.5)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.4 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.2 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 0.3 }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = cwcm_t_S }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 1.5 }
			}
			# own Council lines on the recipient (agriculture, socialist cadres)
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.08 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_AP = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_type = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_eff }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			# the return, read from the recipient every month
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_M = 50 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_M min = 0.2 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.015 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.03 }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_HM = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_M }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ZS = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.03 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_HM = cwcm_t_v }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@oil }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@oil }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@steel }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@steel }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@aluminium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@aluminium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@chromium }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@chromium }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@tungsten }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@tungsten }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_produced@rubber }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_s = resource_consumed@rubber }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_s > cwcm_t_V } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_V = cwcm_t_s }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_V > 4.99 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = cwcm_t_V }
					divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_R = 20 }
					clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_R min = 0.25 max = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_R }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_RS = cwcm_t_S }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.04 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_v max = 0.1 }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_OR = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 3 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_IND = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 4 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 5 } } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_MIL = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 6 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.005 }
						multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
						add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_aidret_KG = cwcm_t_v }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.08 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_REX = cwcm_t_v }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_RS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_RGDP = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = total_unemployed_percentage_display }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_U = 0.08 }
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_U min = 0.25 max = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_U }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_US = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.05 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_POP = cwcm_t_v }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_remit = cwcm_t_US }
				multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_remit = 0.1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_by > 0 } }
					if = {
						limit = { var:global.cwcm_h3_by = { exists = yes  } }
						var:global.cwcm_h3_by = {
							set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.005 }
							multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_US }
							add_to_variable = { cwcm_aidw_AK = cwcm_t_v }
							set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_workers_host
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = 4 } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_reform_gap = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_gap }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_GS = cwcm_t_S }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.02 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_CD = cwcm_t_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_reform_until } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = -0.02 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_GS }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_ret = 5 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 0 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.25 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 1 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 3 } }
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0.15 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { cwcm_east_disc = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_alignment = 2 } }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = 0.01 }
					multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_v = cwcm_t_S }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_x_ST = cwcm_t_v }
				}
			}
		}
		# the interested members pay the programme by GDP share (annual)
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h3_part
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_pg min = 0.001 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_c = 12 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_h3_part
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_pg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_c }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_aid_pay = cwcm_t_x }
			}
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_aidret_HM max = 0.06 }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.cwcm_aidret_OR max = 0.15 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_ext
		COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external_country = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. The Council modifier of a partner country (programmes received and what it gives in return).
COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external_country = {
	clamp_variable = { var = cwcm_x_AP max = 0.12 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_recipient COLDWAR_CMEA_is_associate = yes } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_external } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_external } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_external } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_external } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# Any scope. Refreshes every partner country.
COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_ext
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_external_country = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. While Council programmes abroad run, every member loses Cold War assistance capacity: -1 for a small or medium, -2 for a large programme, at most -3 (as in the EC). A member over its limit gets seven days to end a programme itself.
COLDWAR_CMEA_update_shared_capacity = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_m max = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_aidcap_malus = cwcm_t_m }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_aidcap_malus = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = yes
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
				mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 }
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap } }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap
					set_variable = { cwcm_overcap_due = global.num_days }
					add_to_variable = { cwcm_overcap_due = 7 }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwcm_overcap value = THIS } } }
						add_to_array = { global.cwcm_overcap = THIS }
					}
					COLDWAR_CMEA_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwcm_pv_type = cwcm_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwcm_pv_partner = cwcm_t_bestc }
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.15 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (donor). temp cwcm_t_bestc/cwcm_t_bestn: the own Cold War programme that ends last (the newest), type 1-8 or 9 = public support.
COLDWAR_CMEA_find_newest = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mdcw_cw_out
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p1_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p2_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p3_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p4_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p5_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p6_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p7_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_size@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_p8_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_party@THIS > 0 }
				check_variable = { PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS > cwcm_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = PREV.mdcw_cw_pps_end@THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc = THIS.id }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 9 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope (donor over its limit). Ends the newest own programme through the Cold War end effects; the recipient gets the usual notice.
COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_find_newest = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestc > 0 } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ended_type = cwcm_t_bestn }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ended_partner = cwcm_t_bestc }
		set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_t_by_receiver = 0 }
		var:cwcm_t_bestc = {
			PREV = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 1 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_1 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 2 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_2 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 3 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_3 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 4 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_4 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 5 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_5 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 6 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_6 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 7 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_7 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 8 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_program_8 = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bestn = 9 } }
					mdcw_cw_end_pps = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.16 }
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. After seven days: end the newest programmes until the capacity is no longer exceeded.
COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap_resolve = {
	mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free < 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_end_newest = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
	}
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap
}

# Any scope. Weekly check of members over their assistance capacity.
COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap_tick = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_overcap
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } }
			clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap
		}
		else = {
			mdcw_cw_recalculate_capacity = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_cw_cap_free > -0.5 } }
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_overcap_due } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap_resolve = yes
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_overcap
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap } } add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_clear = THIS } }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwcm_t_clear
		remove_from_array = { global.cwcm_overcap = THIS }
	}
}

# Any scope. Preview for the vote: assistance capacity of every player member now and after the programme in global.cwcm_ui_size, and which own programme would end.
COLDWAR_CMEA_capacity_preview = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_size = 3 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = 1 }
		}
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_m max = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_add = global.cwcm_ui_size }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_size_to_malus = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_capk = cwcm_t_addm }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_m = cwcm_t_addm }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_m max = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_capnew = cwcm_t_m }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwcm_ui_capnew = -1 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pv_now = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pv_used = mdcw_cw_cap_used }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pv_after = mdcw_cw_cap_max }
				subtract_from_variable = { cwcm_pv_after = cwcm_aidcap }
				add_to_variable = { cwcm_pv_after = global.cwcm_ui_capnew }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pv_type = 0 }
				set_variable = { cwcm_pv_partner = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_pv_used > cwcm_pv_after }
						has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_find_newest = yes
					set_variable = { cwcm_pv_type = cwcm_t_bestn }
					set_variable = { cwcm_pv_partner = cwcm_t_bestc }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_addm: capacity loss of a programme of size cwcm_t_add.
COLDWAR_CMEA_size_to_malus = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_add = 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_addm = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_add > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_addm = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_addm = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly: programmes, programmes abroad and members over their capacity.
COLDWAR_CMEA_programmes_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_projects_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_aid_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_overcap_tick = yes
}

# Country scope. Application for membership (players by the window; interface for national focus trees). An inactive member applies to resume its participation.
COLDWAR_CMEA_submit_application = {
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_can_apply = yes }
		set_variable = { cwcm_status = 2 }
		set_variable = { cwcm_applied = global.num_days }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_set_country_data = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_watch = yes
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev17_target = PREV.id } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.17 } }
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Notice of withdrawal: it takes effect after 182 days (Charter, six months).
COLDWAR_CMEA_give_notice = {
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving
	set_variable = { cwcm_leave_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_leave_due = 182 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player member). Withdraws the notice before it takes effect.
COLDWAR_CMEA_withdraw_notice = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_leaving
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Country scope (player member). After the joint declaration (D5): a trade agreement of its own with every member of the European Communities (50 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_ec_trade_agreement = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_ec_trade
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_ec_agreement } }
		add_political_power = -50
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_ec_agreement
		hidden_effect = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwec_members
				if = { limit = { exists = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { sender_nation = PREV.id }
					set_temp_variable = { receiver_nation = THIS.id }
					set_temp_variable = { remove_agreement = 0 }
					set_improved_trade_agreement = yes
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Council programmes abroad running or on their way (global.cwcm_naid).
COLDWAR_CMEA_count_aid = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item = 120 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h1_target > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h2_target > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_h3_target > 0 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_naid = cwcm_t_na }
}
